features.name: duration_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized loan duration using training set mean and std, enabling scale-normalized distance computation for KNN
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes duration to unit scale so it contributes proportionally to Euclidean distance in KNN

features.name: credit_amount_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized credit amount using training set mean and std, enabling scale-normalized distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes credit amount to unit scale preventing it from dominating KNN distance due to large raw values

features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized age using training set mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes age for balanced contribution to KNN distance metric

features.name: credit_duration_interaction
features.description: Log-transformed product of normalized credit amount and duration, capturing joint risk exposure in a compressed scale
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures combined exposure of large loans over long periods, improving neighborhood geometry for similar risk profiles

features.name: installment_burden_ratio
features.description: Ratio of installment commitment rate to existing credits, measuring per-credit payment burden normalized by training mean
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative payment burden per credit line, useful for finding similar financial stress profiles in KNN

features.name: checking_status_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of checking account status from most negative to most positive balance, enabling distance computation on account health
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical checking status into ordered numeric scale reflecting financial health for KNN distance

features.name: savings_status_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of savings account status from lowest to highest savings level
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical savings status into ordered numeric scale for meaningful KNN distance computation

features.name: employment_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of employment duration from unemployed to longest tenure
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts employment duration categories into ordered numeric scale for KNN distance, capturing job stability gradient

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Composite score combining normalized checking status, savings status, and employment ordinals into a single financial stability index
features.expected_model_benefit: Single-dimensional prototype distance feature capturing overall financial stability, improving KNN cluster separation
features.formula: np.clip((np.where(checking_status == '<0', 0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 1, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 2, 3))) / 3.0 + np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 1, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 2, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 3, 4)))) / 4.0 + np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0, np.where(employment == '<1', 1, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 2, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 3, 4)))) / 4.0) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: credit_amount_log_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed credit amount normalized by training mean log value, reducing skewness for better distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces right-skew in credit amount distribution, improving KNN distance symmetry for high-value loans

features.name: high_risk_profile_indicator
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall risk profile based on combination of checking status, savings level, employment stability, and loan burden. Score 0 indicates very low risk profile (positive checking, high savings, stable employment, low installment), score 1 indicates very high risk profile (negative checking, low savings, unstable employment, high installment commitment). Intermediate values reflect mixed risk signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic risk prototype distance anchor for KNN, grouping similar risk profiles together in feature space

features.name: loan_purpose_risk_score
features.description: Semantic risk score for loan purpose based on typical repayment patterns and asset backing. Score near 0 indicates lower-risk purposes (used car, real estate, education with asset backing), score near 1 indicates higher-risk purposes (retraining, repairs, other with limited asset backing). Radio/TV and new car fall in middle range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain knowledge about loan purpose risk into a continuous scale for KNN neighborhood similarity on purpose-based risk
